Strategic partnership to develop local production capabilities for H&N layer breeding stock, strengthening domestic poultry production and supply-chain resilience in support of food security across the UAE and wider GCC

Press Release

  • Project is expected to be the first in the UAE dedicated to layer parent stock production, reducing reliance on imports and supporting the UAE’s position as an emerging regional hub for advanced poultry breeding, a major milestone toward a self-sufficient poultry industry. 

Abu Dhabi, UAE – Ghitha Holding PJSC (“Ghitha” or the “Group”; ADX: GHITHA), a diversified conglomerate spanning agriculture, food production, and distribution, and a subsidiary of 2PointZero Group, has signed a strategic partnership agreement with H&N International GmbH (“H&N”), one of the world’s leading layer breeding companies. The partnership will establish local production and distribution capabilities for H&N layer breeding stock, supporting egg production across the UAE and the wider GCC.

Under the partnership, the Group’s subsidiary, Al Ain Farms, will establish local capabilities for the production of H&N layer parent stock, the breeding birds that produce commercial laying hens, and day-old commercial layer chicks, as part of Ghitha’s broader poultry sourcing and production strategy. The benefit of the project will be utilized by all Ghitha’s layer sites (Al Ain Farms, Al Jazira, and Arabian Farms) as well as the local farms and wider GCC market.  The project is expected to be the first in the UAE dedicated to layer parent stock production, strengthening local poultry production capabilities and reducing reliance on imports.

The collaboration will combine Ghitha’s local and regional capabilities with H&N’s international breeding expertise and technology, supporting greater integration across the poultry value chain and strengthening access to high-quality H&N layer breeding for producers across the region.

Falal Ameen, CEO of Ghitha Holding, said: “The partnership with H&N International marks an important step in strengthening our integrated food and agriculture platform and advancing the localization of poultry production capabilities in the UAE. By establishing local production of H&N layer parent stock alongside our existing poultry sourcing network, we are strengthening supply-chain resilience and reducing reliance on imports, while bringing international breeding expertise and technology closer to producers in the region. The collaboration will also expand our ability to serve customers across the UAE and the wider GCC, reinforcing our commitment to supporting the UAE’s food security objectives and building a more resilient and integrated regional food ecosystem.”

Xabier Arbe Ugalde, Managing Director, H&N International GmbH, said: “Our partnership with Ghitha Holding represents an important milestone in expanding H&N’s presence in the UAE and wider GCC region. Establishing local parent stock production will help strengthen the reliability and efficiency of regional supply chains, while supporting the continued development of a more resilient and self-sufficient poultry industry. We look forward to working closely with Ghitha to advance local breeding capabilities and contribute to the region’s long-term food security ambitions.”

The collaboration supports the UAE’s food security and agricultural sustainability objectives by strengthening local capabilities within the poultry value chain. Through the partnership, Ghitha and H&N aim to contribute to a more secure and sustainable regional supply of H&N layer breeding stock while supporting greater vertical integration across the industry.

Looking ahead, the partnership will support customers across the UAE and wider GCC markets, contributing to the continued development of regional poultry production capabilities and greater regional self-sufficiency.

About H&N:

H&N International GmbH offers parent stock selected to breed layers that are good at everything and at home anywhere.

Since 1945, the company has worked with its own genetic pools and, to this day, offers commercial layer breeders around the world highly adaptable parent stock.

H&N birds are selected to adapt to any local climate, housing, feeding, and market demand. Commercial egg producers can thus become more independent of, and protected against, changing conditions—especially feed price volatility.

They can regain greater control and flexibility to meet and exceed changing local market demands, as their production of sellable eggs remains consistently high despite external changes.

H&N International serves customers all over the world. Succeeding across contrasting market demands and environmental conditions requires substantial genetic innovation.

H&N International research the common denominators required to produce profitably with different feed resources and under hot, humid, cold, arid, cage, and cage-free conditions, while successfully meeting ever-changing market demands for white, brown, and tinted eggs in different sizes and high numbers over production cycles extending beyond 100 weeks.

About Ghitha Holding:

Ghitha Holding PJSC is a private joint stock company incorporated in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It operates as a subsidiary of 2PointZero. Ghitha emerged as an investment holding company; with its portfolio of operating subsidiaries and associates consisting of: Al Ain Farms, Marmum Dairy Farm, Al Jazira Poultry Farm, Arabian Farms, Al Ajban Poultry, Alliance Food Company, Zee Stores International, Delice Supermarket, Agrinv (Al Hashemeya), Royal Horizon Holding, Abu Dhabi Vegetable Oil Company, Mirak, NRTC Group, Ripe Fresh Trading LLC, Taaza Healthy Food Industries LLC, Taaza Quality Foodstuff Trading LLC, Apex Investment PSC (ADX: APEX), Invictus Investments (ADX: INVICTUS), and International Food Industries. The Group is collectively engaged in dairy, poultry, fish, agriculture, food commodities, edible oils, trading, and distribution.
